waveName: Wave 2 – Workspace safety UI, Android platform, honest colours & preview, photo intake, design system

package.title: Safe recompute, save status, real step navigation and empty states
package.goal: Recompute can no longer silently wipe laying progress or manual edits. Save failures are visible. Back and forward move between steps. Opening a project resumes where the user left off. Every step shows its status and what to do next.
steps:
Route-driven steps:
- Take the step from the initialStep prop when it is valid, otherwise 'photo'.
- User navigation (stepper, Zurück/Weiter, badges) pushes the hash, so browser back/forward and the Android back button move between steps.
- Capture the route step once in a ref. Only when the route had no step, redirect after load with replaceState: to 'plan' if placed > 0, otherwise to 'preview'.
onDone: setStep(cur => cur === 'compute' ? 'preview' : cur). If the user is on another step, show a 'Berechnung fertig – Vorschau öffnen' badge instead.

On every step change after the first, scrollTo(0). Centre the active stepper chip with stepper.scrollLeft, not scrollIntoView.
In w2-workspace-shell.css:
- Sticky stepper under the topbar for widths ≥ 601 px and heights ≥ 700 px.
- Sticky .step-nav at the bottom for widths ≤ 980 px, z-index 15, with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding and a centred 'Schritt n/10' counter.
- Put the step intro on the same line as the h2.

Stepper status:
- 'done' ✓ for photo when a bitmap exists, and for compute, preview and plan when computed && !stale.
- Warn dot when stale.
- aria-current on the active step.
- Steps 8-10 without a result get aria-disabled and a title, but stay clickable.

Empty states: Workspace renders EmptyState instead of the step component.
- preview, plan and pdf without a result: button that goes to step 7, or to step 1 if there is no photo.
- shapes and compute without a photo: button that goes to step 1.
- On step 1 without a photo, keep 'Weiter' enabled with the hint 'Foto kann auch später gewählt werden'.
- On step 7 without a current result, the primary button becomes 'Berechnen' and runs the guarded compute.

SaveStatus in ws-head shows 'Gespeichert ✓', 'Speichert…' or 'Nicht gespeichert'. On saveState 'error', show a role=alert banner with 'Erneut versuchen' (api.retrySave) and 'Sicherung herunterladen' (api.exportCurrent → downloadBlob). On api.integrityError, show 'Gespeichertes Mosaik passt nicht zur Palette – bitte neu berechnen'.

Recompute guard: if computed && (progress.total.placed > 0 || manualEdits > 0), open a Modal before computing. Text: '{placed} verlegte Steine und {edits} manuelle Änderungen gehen verloren'. Buttons:
- [Sicherungskopie anlegen und neu berechnen] (default): api.createBackupCopy('(vor Neuberechnung <Datum>)'), then compute, then show the name of the copy. If the backup fails, abort and offer exportCurrent.
- [Ohne Sicherung neu berechnen] in danger style.
- [Abbrechen].
Show compute.overwriteWarn as a warn line with the live counts.

Stale reasons:
- Diff the parsed rec.computedWith against computeKey(rec) by group: l = Größe/Steine/Fuge, a = Fotobearbeitung, rg = Bereiche, sh = Formen, pm/cc/cp/mi = Farben, di/de = Farbmischung, im = Foto ersetzt.
- Show 'Geändert seit letzter Berechnung: …'. The header badge reads 'Einstellungen geändert'.
- Add 'Änderungen verwerfen', which restores settings, adjust and regions from computedWith.

Diagnostics wording (ext overrides):
- 'Ø Farbabweichung je Stein (ΔE)' plus a rating word ('kaum sichtbar' < 2, 'erkennbar' 2-5, 'deutlich' > 5), shown only when deltaE is '2000'.
- deHint mentions that tile-size detail loss is not measured.
- Override compute.phase.lab to 'Farben umrechnen' and step.compute.intro.
acceptance: e2e: mark section A1 done and click recompute. The modal appears with 1.526 laid stones. Backup creates a copy in 'Meine Projekte' with placed-count 1.526. Abbrechen leaves progress unchanged.

e2e: going from colors to preview and then goBack shows step colors, and the active stepper button matches the hash. Reopening a computed project from 'Meine Projekte' lands on Vorschau, or on Verlegeplan once stones are laid.
e2e: a compute that finishes while the user is on step 'joint' leaves the step unchanged and shows the done badge.
e2e at 390×844: after each Weiter tap the step h2 is in the viewport, and .step.active lies within the stepper bounds.
e2e: steps 8-10 without a result show a button that leads to step 7.
e2e: with IDB put patched to throw, the alert banner appears. After unpatching, 'Erneut versuchen' persists the rename across a reload.
package.risk: Effort M-L. pushState navigation must not reload the project; Workspace stays keyed by id. Test StrictMode double effects.

findings.title: "Neu berechnen" silently wipes laying progress and manual stone edits (no confirm, no undo)
findings.problem: Any trivial change after computing (e.g. brightness +1 in step 1) turns the project stale. The orange stale badge in the header jumps straight to step 7, and one click on "Neu berechnen" replaces the mosaic. That throws away all marked progress and every manual colour/shape/freeform edit, with no confirmation and no undo (the README says undo does not exist). The only warning is a grey, small-print line under the button.

1) Guard against data loss (effort S, do this first). In StepCompute's compute-btn onClick, if api.computed exists and (api.progress.total.placed > 0 or there are manual edits), open the existing <Modal> from components.tsx:107 instead of computing straight away.

2) Exact edit marker, no invented numbers (S).

findings.title: Recomputing deletes all laying progress and manual stone edits without asking, and the 'stale' badge sends the user straight to it
findings.problem: Any change in computeKey shows the clickable badge 'Einstellungen geändert – neu berechnen', even a trivial one such as switching the ΔE formula, dither, brightness or a region. The badge leads to the compute step. There the only safeguard is a grey muted sentence. One click on 'Neu berechnen' replaces the mosaic, palette edits, shape edits and the whole progress bitmask. This happens even when the grid is identical. There is no confirm, no snapshot and no undo (the README says 'Rückgängig: nicht vorhanden'). For a user who has already laid thousands of stones (requirement 14: progress persisted), this is irreversible data loss.

Do these in priority order. Steps A and B are S effort and fix the data loss. Step C is M effort and optional.

A) Ask before replacing progress or manual edits (StepCompute.tsx, useProject.ts, i18n de/en/tr)
- Add `meta.manualEdits?: number` to ProjectRecord.
- In `touchMosaic`, increment it through `update(r => ({...r, meta: {...r.meta, manualEdits: (r.meta.manualEdits ?? 0) + 1}}))`.
- In `compute()`, reset it to 0 on success.
- In the StepCompute onClick, check this condition: `api.computed && ((api.progress?.total.placed ?? 0) > 0 || (rec.meta.manualEdits ?? 0) > 0)`.
- If it is true, open the existing `Modal` from components.tsx:107 instead of computing. Use `Modal`, not `confirm()`, because it needs three buttons.
- Modal text, filled with real numbers from `api.progress.total` and the counter: "Neu berechnen ersetzt den Plan. Verloren gehen: 1.383 als verlegt markierte Steine (24,9 %) und 3 manuelle Änderungen."
- Button 1, the default and highlighted: "Sicherungskopie anlegen und neu berechnen". It runs `await api.flush(); await duplicateProject(id, '– vor Neuberechnung ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString())`, then `api.compute()`, then reports where the copy is ("Kopie unter Meine Projekte").
- Button 2, styled as danger: "Ohne Kopie neu berechnen".
- Button 3: "Abbrechen".
- Change de.ts:229 from `muted` to `warn` styling, and show it only when the modal condition is false.
- Do NOT add a hidden versions store. `duplicateProject` (storage/projects.ts:34) already gives a full snapshot the user can see and delete. It needs no IndexedDB schema bump and does not silently multiply storage for projects with millions of stones.

B) Make the stale badge say what changed (useProject.ts, Workspace.tsx)
- Add `staleReasons(rec)`. It parses `rec.computedWith` and compares each top-level field with `computeKey(rec)`: l / sh / pm / cc / di / de / mi / cp / a / rg.
- For `l`, also compare the sub-fields: size, tile, joint, edge mode and min cut.
- Map each changed field to an i18n label and show them on the badge, e.g. "Geändert: ΔE-Formel, Helligkeit".
- If progress > 0, add a second line: "(Neu berechnen setzt Verlegefortschritt zurück)".
- The badge still only navigates. It never triggers the compute itself.

C) Optional, M effort: keep progress for stones that are exactly the same
- Only when `JSON.stringify(old.layoutParams) === JSON.stringify(new.layoutParams)`, and before the new mosaic replaces the old one in useProject.ts (around line 345).
- For each cell with old progress bits, keep the bits only if all of these hold:
  - `kind` is equal;
  - the geometry is bit-identical: line params Float32 equal, the same sub k, and identical free pieces;
  - each piece's colour is equal when compared by the palette hex (or materialId when set) through the old and new palettes. Never compare by palette index: mosaic.ts:549-576 renumbers the palette by lightness on every compute.
- Otherwise drop that cell's bits.
- Afterwards, report: "N verlegte Steine übernommen; M bereits verlegte Steine haben im neuen Plan eine andere Farbe/Form". Offer a list or highlight of those M cells, because they physically exist on the board.
- Never set a laid bit for a piece that is not provably identical. Totals and stats keep coming from the data, so geometry and count guarantees are untouched.
- Add a vitest test: recomputing with identical settings keeps 100 % of the progress, and changing the joint keeps 0 % with a clear message.

findings.title: Recompute silently wipes laying progress and all manual stone edits, with no confirmation and no backup
findings.problem: Clicking 'Neu berechnen' replaces MosaicData, including the progress bitmask and every manual colour or shape edit, and saves the new zero progress straight away. Requirement 14 says progress must be persisted, and requirement 13 depends on manual edits being kept. There is no confirm dialog, no snapshot and no undo. The only safeguard is a grey sentence below the button. The 'stale' badge also keeps prompting the user to recompute after any setting change.

corrected:
1) Guard (effort S, highest value). In StepCompute's onClick, compute `placed = api.progress?.total.placed` and a `hasEdits` flag (see step 3). If either is non-zero, show a modal instead of a passive line. Example text: "1.526 verlegte Steine und manuelle Änderungen gehen verloren." Buttons: "Sicherung anlegen und neu berechnen", "Ohne Sicherung neu berechnen", "Abbrechen". The backup button calls the existing duplicateProject(id, t('compute.backupSuffix')) from src/storage/projects.ts, which already copies the record, image, mosaic and progress, then calls api.compute(). Optionally also offer exportProject() as a file download. No new IndexedDB store is needed. Add i18n keys to de, en and tr.

2) Exact progress carry-over (effort M), only when it can be proven exact. Inside compute(), before replacing computedRef, keep `old = computedRef.current`. Carry over only when old.layout.cols, rows and every colW[i] and rowH[j] equal the new layout's (or layoutParamsOf is deep-equal). For each cell idx, copy old.progress[idx] only when:
- the kind is equal;
- the geometry is equal: cellGeomKey for non-free cells; for FREE cells, the same number of pieces and the same poly points;
- every piece's palette HEX is equal, comparing old palette[oldColor].hex with res.palette[newColor].hex.
Leave every other cell unplaced. Report "X von Y verlegten Steinen übernommen, Z haben sich geändert (Abschnitte …) – bitte prüfen". Never guess.

3) Edit preservation (effort M). Add an `edited: Uint8Array` to MosaicData (types.ts) and to its serialization (pack and unpack in serialize.ts, TYPED and export in projects.ts). setPieceColor, setCellKind and setFreePieces in edits.ts set it to 1. Its popcount gives the exact edit count for the modal. After a recompute with identical layout geometry (same test as step 2), offer "manuelle Änderungen übernehmen". This copies the edited cells' kind, line, sub and free data, and maps each colour by HEX into the new palette. If a HEX is missing, add it with addPaletteColor; in materials mode, skip that cell and list it instead. Each restored free cell must pass validateFreePieces again. If the layout geometry differs, do not offer the re-apply at all, because FreePiece.poly is in absolute mm.

Phase 1 (effort S, do first, impact 5). Guard plus automatic backup, with no schema change.

- In StepCompute.tsx, replace the direct onClick at :66 with a check.
- Compute placed with progressOf(api.computed.layout, api.computed.data) (an exact value).
- Add hasManualEdits: a boolean in ProjectRecord.meta. Set it in the useProject wrappers around setPieceColor, setCellKind, setFreePieces and replaceColor. Reset it after compute.
- If placed > 0 or hasManualEdits is set, open a modal. Wording: "{placed} von {total} Steinen sind als verlegt markiert" plus, only if the flag is set, "Manuelle Stein-Änderungen sind vorhanden". Never show an invented count of edited stones.
- Buttons: [Sicherungskopie anlegen und neu berechnen] (default), [Ohne Sicherung neu berechnen], [Abbrechen].
- The backup path:
  1. await api.flush(), so debounced progress and mosaic saves land.
  2. Call duplicateProject(id, `(vor Neuberechnung ${date})`).
  3. Only then call compute().
- If duplicateProject throws (for example QuotaExceededError on Android), abort the recompute. Offer exportProject as a file download instead.
- Add i18n keys in de/en/tr.
- Also rename the header badge text to "Einstellungen geändert" and stop calling the action "neu berechnen", so it no longer nudges toward a destructive click.
- Add an e2e check:
  1. Mark section A1 done.
  2. Click compute.
  3. Expect the modal, then confirm with backup.
  4. Expect the project list to contain the copy.
  5. Expect the copy's placed-count to be 1.526.

Phase 2 (effort M). Exact progress carry-over, only where it is provably identical.

- Keep the old ComputedState and palette in memory until the new result is ready.
- Carry anything over only if JSON.stringify(layoutParamsOf(old)) === JSON.stringify(new lp). This guarantees identical cols, rows, colX/rowY and colW/rowH. Otherwise carry nothing and say so ("Raster geändert – Fortschritt nicht übertragbar, Sicherung vorhanden").
- With an identical layout, per cell: copy the progress bits only if all of the following hold:
  - kind is equal;
  - the raw geometry is equal (line Float32 values bit-equal; sub length equal; freeform polygons deep-equal);
  - every piece's palette HEX is equal after mapping old index to HEX and new index to HEX.
- Report the exact number of previously laid stones that were not carried over, and offer a "betroffene Steine anzeigen" highlight.
- Add a unit test in tests/ to check carry-over:
  - Identical settings should give 100 % carry-over, if compute is deterministic.
  - A joint change should give 0 %.
  - progressOf totals must equal the geometry.

Drop the separate 'versions' IndexedDB store; the Phase 1 duplicate provides the same backup.

Phase 3 (optional, effort L). Re-apply manual edits, or "keep laid stones, re-plan only open areas".

- Only allowed under the same identical-layoutParams condition.
- Needs a persisted per-cell edited mask. That means a serialize.ts format change, plus the TYPED map in projects.ts for export and import.
- Remap colours by HEX. Append any missing HEX to the new palette via addPaletteColor with a new code, and never reuse an old index.

findings.title: Android back button leaves the app from every screen, including open dialogs; in the PWA, back jumps from step 8 to Home
findings.problem: The APK does not include @capacitor/app (package.json; capacitor.plugins.json lists only filesystem and share). Capacitor 8's BridgeActivity has no back handling: there is no OnBackPressedCallback anywhere in @capacitor/android. So the hardware back button or back gesture takes the default Activity path. On Android 12 and newer it sends the app to the background; on Android 7-11 it finishes the activity, which destroys the WebView and restarts the app on Home. Back never closes a dialog and never returns to the previous step. In the browser/PWA, step changes use history.replaceState (Workspace.tsx:23-26) and modals are not in the history, so back always leaves the whole project. Pending saves depend only on visibilitychange/pagehide (useProject.ts:131-141); there is no native pause hook.

globalRules:
Implementation plan for making MosaicPlan "much, much better": 7 waves, 33 work packages, ordered by user impact. The order is: (1) data safety and geometric correctness; (2) workspace safety UI, Android platform, honest colours, honest preview, photo intake and design system; (3) mosaic colour quality, live preview, freeform editor, face/detail guidance, viewer features, PDF foundations and project portability; (4) cut placement and accent colours, laying workbench, progress engine, PDF sheet structure, offline face detector; (5) undo/redo, single-pass stats, viewer back-buffer, PDF content, shopping view, target colours, PDF export UI; (6) deviation map and batch editing, fine-tile materials, colour measuring, streaming CSV, final PDF wiring; (7) docs and e2e consolidation.

RULES FOR EVERY PACKAGE

Files and parallel work
- Packages in the same wave run in parallel. They own disjoint existing files.
- New files may be created freely, but each name must be unique to its package.
- Some packages add optional fields or parameters only so that a package in the next wave can compile. Each one is marked "contract for wave N". Add them exactly as written, even if nothing in your package uses them.

Translations (i18n)
- Put new keys in src/i18n/ext/<package-id>.ts and export {de, en, tr}. The aggregator in src/i18n/index.ts merges every ext file after the base dictionaries.
- All three languages must have the same keys and the same placeholders. tests/i18n.test.ts checks this.
- To change the wording of an existing key, override it in your own ext file. First grep src/i18n/ext to make sure no other ext file already overrides that key.
- Never edit de.ts, en.ts or tr.ts.

CSS
- Only w2-design-system edits src/ui/styles.css.
- Every other package puts its CSS in src/ui/css/<package-id>.css and imports it from a component it owns.

Tests
- Unit tests go in tests/<package-id>*.test.ts.
- Browser checks are standalone Playwright scripts at e2e/<package-id>.e2e.cjs, run against `npm run preview`.
- Only w7-docs-e2e touches e2e/run-e2e.cjs and README.md.
- The golden mosaic hash fixture is tests/golden/mosaic-hashes.json. It hashes kind, c1, c2, rec, sub, line, free and palette hex+code, but not names. It is owned by whichever package owns src/core/mosaic.ts in that wave. Any change to it must be deliberate and explained in the PR.

Quality bar
- Every package must leave `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and the existing `node e2e/run-e2e.cjs` green.
- Every package must keep the exact-geometry and count guarantees: totals equal the geometry, and cut dimensions come only from analyzeCut on real polygons.
- Anything estimated must be labelled 'Schätzung' or 'Richtwert'. Requirement 18 holds everywhere.
deferred: Grout compensation in computeMosaic (algo-quality#0, part 4). Both reviewers called it optional and off by default, and recommending a grout plus an honest preview gives most of the benefit. Changing the factory grout default from #BDB8AE to #808080 is deferred too; the recommendation never overwrites the user's choice.

Linear-light averaging of stone target colours (algo-quality#10). Measured gains are within k-means noise on natural photos. Revisit it together with linear-light resizing in imageOps, with a measured A/B benchmark.

Mixed tile sizes stage 2: zones with their own grid (spec-gaps#2). Wave 6 delivers stage 1, real fine-tile materials for k×k sub-stones plus fine regions. Zones touch every per-cell structure (progress mask, IDs, sections, hit-testing, PDF), and the tiles-step badge stays honest until then.

Movable section boundaries and a seam optimiser (spec-gaps#9). This is impact 2-3 and needs new settings across layout, viewer, worker and PDF. Paper-matched section presets (wave 6) cover the main paper-waste pain.
Full SVG export of plans and templates (spec-gaps#12). The vector PDF at 1:1 or custom paper already covers plotters. Only PNG preview export is built (wave 6).

Diff-based incremental statistics in a worker that keeps its own mosaic copy, and dirty-pixel overview updates (performance-scale#5, parts 2-3). They are replaced by the 8-13x single-pass stats (wave 5), coalesced stats jobs and O(1) progress counters (wave 4). Revisit only if 5M-stone edits are still slower than about 1 s.
Splitting the shape analysis across several workers (performance-scale#7, part b). The hot-loop fix gives about 4x. SharedArrayBuffer is not available without COOP/COEP headers.
One CSV per section, delivered as a ZIP (performance-scale#1). Streaming CSV plus the Excel row-limit warning are built; a store-only ZIP can follow if users ask.
Automatic stock-constrained recolouring (spec-gaps#4, part 4). It would change how the image looks and is often impossible. Exact shortfall and shopping lists are built instead.

Error-driven k-means swap refinement and detail-weighted palette samples (algo-quality#6, optional part). Measured gains were inconsistent. Pinned accent colours confirmed by the user are built instead.
Dither error diffusion through split/SUB cells, serpentine scanning and face/edge damping (algo-quality#1). Measured as useless or harmful.
Global cut budget, 'max. Schnittzellen' (algo-quality#3, phase 2). The background cut factor in wave 4 gives most of the value.
Image-level Canny/polyline contour extraction (algo-quality#5). Unproven, and it would defeat template reuse. Only the opt-in grid-preserving continuity bonus is built.
Haptic feedback with the VIBRATE permission (ux-mobile-android#2). The text status line and flash highlight already give feedback.
A native 'pause' flush registry through @capacitor/app (ux-mobile-android#1). beforeunload with commit(), visibilitychange and minimizeApp already cover saving.
MediaPipe face detection. Its 14.6 MB wasm exceeds the PWA precache limit; pico.js is used instead (wave 4).
Colour-chart sheet mode for measuring many tiles from one photo (spec-gaps#7, phase 2).
First-fit-decreasing packing of mixed-width strips into shared raw tiles (correctness-core#5, optional). The current per-shape-group count is a safe upper bound.
Mixed page orientations per section and tighter print margins (pdf-print#4). Mixed orientations risk print-dialog auto-scaling, which breaks 1:1. Smaller margins clip on common printers.
Undo history that persists across reloads (ux-desktop#7). The journal is in memory for the session only, and the README will say so.
